data.one_liner: Validates Turkish Republic Identification Numbers (TCKN) in Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides logic to check if a given Turkish Republic Identification Number (TCKN) meets all official length, digit, and checksum algorithmic requirements.
use_when: You are building a Flutter application that collects user identity information for Turkish citizens.
You need a quick validation check for TCKN input fields.
avoid_when: You need verification services against a live government database (this package only checks the algorithmic format).
strengths: Implements the exact official TCKN checksum and digit rules.
Cross-platform support including Android, iOS, web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
weaknesses: Limited to a single specific validation use-case.
Documentation and API usage details in the README are sparse.
